items.title: New Arrivals From HBX: Needles
items.summary: Brand Information: Needles, an in-house label of Nepenthes, was founded by designer Keizo Shimizu in 1988. With all products manufactured in Japan, Needles is notable for blending old Western military style with Japanese textiles. Fan-favourite pieces, including tracksuits, track pants and reconstructed military jackets, have gained popularity with celebrities such as A$AP Rocky and Virgil Abloh.
